title: AIFUYI inquiry
description: The one shape an inquiry travels in: browser builder -> email/WhatsApp text -> (optionally) POST endpoint -> quoting sheet. Keep this file and rfq.js in step; if a field is added in one, add it in the other.

size.description: Nominal diameter, chosen separately from pitch. Free text survives 'Other' so imperial and M18+ threads are not lost.

pitch.description: Pitch in mm. Not every pitch exists on every diameter: M10 allows 1.25/1.5, M12 allows 1.25/1.5/1.75, M14 allows 1.25/1.5/2.0, M16 allows 1.5/2.0. The builder disables impossible pairs rather than accepting them.

thread.description: Derived display string, 'size × pitch'. Convenience only; size and pitch are the source of truth.

length.description: Length under head (underside of head to end of thread). Preset in mm, or free text when typed.

length_mm.description: Numeric form when it could be parsed; used for the price band.

material.description: Class as well as grade — 40Cr at 10.9 and at 12.9 are different parts. 'Other material' carries material_other.

material_other.description: Free text when material is 'Other material'.

finish.description: Coating system. Salt-spray hours belong on the drawing, not in this field.

finish_other.description: Free text when finish is 'Other finish'.

qty.description: Pieces per size and finish. 3,000 is the tooling break-even for this shop; above 50,000 the job becomes a separate programme and is quoted by a person, not by the page.

incoterm.description: Empty string when the buyer has not chosen. Only FOB and CIF name a loading port.

port.description: Loading port, meaningful only with FOB or CIF. Ningbo is the default because it is the nearest box terminal to Yuhuan.

who.description: Buyer name and company, as typed.

drawing.description: Never uploaded by the website. The buyer attaches the file in their own mail or WhatsApp client; this records that it is expected.

estimate.description: Indicative band shown to the buyer. Advisory only - the quote is issued after drawing review.
